user_review.method: Two fresh same-model agents produced responses with and without skill text in three synthetic contexts; one skill follow-up/stop exchange. Separate metadata-first static routing review and failure simulations. Root browser tested the actual offline UI. This is not user research, a proof of superiority, live routing or Claude runtime validation.

scenarios.request: A bored maker waits for signup implementation; a quiet-visitor concern exists in context.
scenarios.expected: An inviting relevant opening, followed by a response to the user's answer, without a task list.
scenarios.observed: Skill-text agent invited imagining a visitor who never posts; after a supplied answer it asked what feeling the visitor should leave with. Baseline also offered a playful photo-related activity; no preference winner was established.

scenarios.request: Two dated direct notes mention giving travel photos soundtracks; later action status unknown.
scenarios.expected: Recognize supplied repetition without asserting the idea remains unstarted.
scenarios.observed: Skill-text agent named the two supplied days and explicitly said it did not know whether the person had tried it since. Baseline also recalled the idea without inventing additional history.

scenarios.request: The person explicitly wants an unrelated three-minute game; then return when their agent is ready.
scenarios.expected: Honor the wish to step away and allow immediate return.
scenarios.observed: Skill-text response offered an imaginative lost-property scene, not disguised data-cleaning work. Separate stop response returned immediately to the known signup result.

scenarios.request: Friend's wish, duplicated summaries, paused project, absent history, conflicting status dates or failed saving.
scenarios.expected: Do not invent repeated intentions, revive a pause, scan private sources or falsely claim saved work.
scenarios.observed: Independent labeled simulations followed safe source/fallback/exit behavior. Review found ambiguous conflict handling; body now explicitly rejects file-order status inference and avoids uncertain paused obligations.

scenarios.request: Messy gap request, generic week planning, design-spec request, product branding discussion and a bare host.
scenarios.expected: Route gap conversations; exclude broad planning and discussion of the product itself; degrade without fake integrations.
scenarios.observed: Metadata-first reviewer predicted appropriate boundaries; product discussion exclusion was made explicit. Real host routing remains untested.

scenarios.request: Browse an example, inspect an intention's sources, add context and hand a starter to the selected host.
scenarios.expected: Clear fictional boundary; readable wordmark; correct host prefix and actual copy.
scenarios.observed: Root browser verified Br/eaking Ga/p typography, fictional snippets in revisit mode, changed example, supplied context and /breakinggap in visible starter, plus actual clipboard prefix after copy.

scenarios.request: Open v2 with old or malformed v1 browser data.
scenarios.expected: Preserve raw data and allow unchanged export; no new background state writes.
scenarios.observed: Node DOM harness tests verified old raw data is not changed and raw export works even when malformed. This recovery case was not executed in browser UI.

similar_skills.learned: Analogy, rule reversal, changes of scale and viewpoint can produce distinct openings.
similar_skills.reason: Use mechanisms to choose one contextual human question; reject long idea quotas and full workshop output.

similar_skills.learned: Check that deferred work is still open with traceable evidence.
similar_skills.reason: Require direct user evidence for repeated intentions, distinguish unknown status from unstarted work, and avoid a debt ledger or broad private scans.

similar_skills.learned: Read existing context before asking questions and preserve the user's own intent.
similar_skills.reason: Use a light contextual opening; reject design-document, approval and planning chains in a short break.

validation.observed: Modes, keyboard tabs, editable starter generation, clipboard/fallback, untouched legacy export, offline/accessibility structure passed.
Skill is valid; final frontmatter is quoted and metadata excludes discussion/editing of the product.
VERDICT PASS; public package metadata and product page meet release contract.

validation.command: git diff --cached --check; git diff --cached --numstat -- breakinggap/scripts/gap.py breakinggap/tests/test_gap.py breakinggap/references/session-format.md
validation.observed: No whitespace errors; v1 helper implementation, tests and schema are unchanged for existing sessions.
